name: Green River Holding Co. Ltd.
summary: Green River Holding Co. Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and sale of various wood-based products, including engineered particle boards, diverse solid wood items, and resins. Their product portfolio also features parawood, solid rubberwood panels, and raw rubberwood materials. Beyond its core production, the company is involved in investment ventures. Established in 2000 and headquartered in Songkhla, Thailand, Green River Holding distributes its offerings across Thailand, Malaysia, China, Indonesia, Korea, and Vietnam, in addition to serving broader international markets.
